name: Jellyfin2 PopFeed
description: Automatically post watched movies to PopFeed via AT Protocol. When you finish a movie on Jellyfin, it checks if it already exists on your PopFeed feed and posts it if it's new.

versions.changelog: Fixed startup crash. Added missing NuGet dependencies (Microsoft.Extensions.Http, Microsoft.AspNetCore.App). Rewrote config page as Jellyfin dashboard UI fragment with proper form lifecycle.

Fixed bugs: (1) Save Settings no longer overwrites auth tokens, (2) Test Connection works after Authenticate, (3) Connection status persists on page refresh, (4) Password field label updated to be PDS-agnostic.
